description: Worktree setup, read from <workspace>/.cursor/worktrees.json when an agent worktree is created. Mirrors Cursor's vscode://schemas/cursor/worktrees (Cursor 3.25.9, workbench.glass.main.js @43381934): the worktree copy of the file wins over the root-workspace copy; a failing setup script does not block worktree creation.

setup-worktree.description: Setup to run inside a newly created worktree (generic fallback). Either an array of shell commands or a path to a script file relative to this JSON file.

setup-worktree-unix.description: UNIX (macOS/Linux) specific setup. Either an array of shell commands or a path to a script file relative to this JSON file. Takes precedence over setup-worktree on UNIX.

setup-worktree-windows.description: Windows specific setup. Either an array of commands or a path to a script file relative to this JSON file. Takes precedence over setup-worktree on Windows.
